about: A Zork II-style underground adventure. You start in a barrow, cross a ravine, and explore gardens, a disorienting carousel room, a riddle room, a bank with a magic vault, a dragon and an ice room. A bumbling Wizard keeps appearing to curse you. The aim seems to be collecting the treasures he took from the Empire.

done.why: I went through the curtain of light into a bare Small Room with no exits. I'd put my valuables in the gnome's box and he vanished with it. I tried the walls, waiting, speech and every direction, and nothing worked. The sword was also left behind because my inventory was full.

moments.note: The Wizard appears and curses me with Fumble, so I drop the lamp.
Answered the riddle with 'well' and the stone door opened.
The bucket and the etched letters in the Circular Room had no obvious use.
Inventory limit stopped me picking the sword back up.
Stuck in the Small Room, which has no exits, after depositing my treasures.

wished: A hint about how to leave the vault room
A way to carry more items
To get past the dragon and cross the stone bridge

lines.line: There is a deafening clap of thunder and the stone door quietly swings open to reveal a passageway beyond.
This is a small, bare room with no distinguishing features. There are no exits from this room.
lines.why: This is where I got stuck.

fun.why: Good exploration and the riddle was a pleasure, but I ended up stuck in the vault.

engagement.why: I was hooked while exploring, then blocked.

difficulty.why: The vault exit was opaque, and the bucket and ice puzzles never resolved.

interestingness.why: Familiar Zork II places with new touches such as the ice and the wizard's curses.

prose.why: Evocative room descriptions and good character moments with the Wizard and the gnome.
